bio: Daniel Reid Topping was born at Greenwich, Connecticut, on 11 June 1912, a son of Henry Junkins Topping and a grandson of John A. Topping of Republic Iron & Steel. He was part-owner and president of the New York Yankees from 1945 to 1964, and died on 18 May 1974. Whether his grandfather's family connects to the Southampton Toppings in John's ancestry is unproven.
